channel.title: The Ottawa Citizen - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Ottawa Citizen (ottawacitizen.com)

item.title: Can love mend a broken heart? Growing evidence shows it makes a difference
item.description: New research suggests that being in a strong relationship can improve a patient’s recovery from heart disease and even protect against it.

item.title: Ottawa Liberal MPs silent on return-to-office after Fanjoy breaks ranks
item.description: Carleton MP Bruce Fanjoy called on the government to reconsider its return-to-office mandate, while other Ottawa-area MPs have refused to comment.

item.title: Learning about how map turtles hibernate might help protect a vulnerable species
item.description: Carleton University prof Grégory Bulté found that turtles settled down for winter rest in Opinicon Lake had been attacked by predators.

item.title: Ottawa man dead, four taken to hospital after Highway 17 collision near Renfrew
item.description: Highway 17 was closed between Storyland Road and Bruce Street after the crash, the OPP said

item.title: Former Ottawa 67's assistant Vince Malette made his mark on and off the ice
item.description: Vince Malette was given the devastating diagnosis 11 years ago that he had early onset Alzheimer's disease

item.title: Ottawa council directs OC Transpo to explore compensation for service disruptions
item.description: A motion that passed Wednesday suggests forms of compensation that could include refunds, capital improvements to reliability and discounted future service.

item.title: Your garbage collection day could soon change: Here's why
item.description: About half of the city's residents will have to put their garbage out on the curb on a different day of the week starting March 30.

item.title: New Defence Investment Agency hiring up to 400, may look outside public service
item.description: Bringing in a small number of outside workers would make "good sense," CEO Doug Guzman said Tuesday.

item.title: Man shot dead, two in custody in Ottawa's third homicide of 2026
item.description: The shooting occurred at the intersection of Bankfield Road and Prince of Wales Drive just before 4:30 p.m. Wednesday

item.title: Jaeden Nelson records first OHL shutout as Ottawa 67's keep rolling with win over Oshawa
item.description: The win lifted the 67's to the top of the Ontario Hockey League's overall standings.
